content:
Jen K.: Quick heads-up — we are GA-ing Aurora StreamTool (hosted) today for general availability. It combines low-latency streaming with first-class tool-calling and structured responses. Plan: staged rollout by region, canary keys first, then 100% in 48h. :tada:
Samir P.: Awesome — what are the model names / endpoints?
Jen K.: Primary endpoint: POST /v1/generate with model="aurora-streamtool-v1". Also new streaming endpoint /v1/stream/generate for real-time.
KT: Any migration required for existing tool-calling apps?
Jen K.: Minimal. If you were using the old toolcall field, switch to the new "tools" array. Backwards-compatible wrappers available, but we recommend updating to the new schema to get structured outputs and streaming hooks. Migration guide: https://internal.redwood.dev/docs/aurora-migration
Matt R.: Runtime notes: Aurora is optimized for 2x lower median latency on short sequences due to new kv-cache sharding. Batching defaults changed (autoBatch: true). If you have custom batching configs, please validate.
Lina (docs): I'll add a quick diff snippet in the migration doc, plus an example JS SDK snippet.
Samir P.: Are there any quota or rate-limit changes we should flag to customers?
Sylvia (product): Hosted quota tiers unchanged. We added a new per-connection streaming limit (concurrent_streams default 10). We'll surface it in billing > quotas.
eng-oncall: Noted. Any special rollback triggers?
Matt R.: Yes — controller will fallback to compatible model group (aurora-compat) automatically on <5xx errors. Ops playbook: if region error rate > 5% for 3m, flip canary off and rollback flag.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by matt.r for aurora-streamtool-v1 canary -> region us-west-2 (deploy id: deploy-205555-aurora-1)
Jen K.: Canary keys created: header X-Redwood-Canary: aurora-canary-2055. We will DM the canary list with keys. If you need access, ping me.
Lina (docs): Example curl snippet I'll paste here:
```
curl -s -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"aurora-streamtool-v1","input":"Summarize the following...","tools":[{"name":"search","spec":"v1"}]}'
```
Samir P.: Nice. SDKs?
Jen K.: JS/Go/Python SDK updates landing in the next patch. JS example (preview):
```js
const resp = await client.stream.generate({ model: 'aurora-streamtool-v1', input: '...', tools: [...] });
for await (const chunk of resp) { console.log(chunk); }
```
Sylvia (product): Marketing will send the external customer email tomorrow. Internal tip: highlight the 2x latency improvement and structured tool outputs.
eng-oncall: I'll watch alerts for the next 6 hours. Please add a Datadog dashboard tile: aurora.stream.tool.calls.latency.p50/p95.
Matt R.: Added short-term dashboards and a synthetic that hits endpoint every 30s.
Jen K.: Deprecation note: the legacy toolcall endpoint (model=toolcall-legacy) will be supported for 90 days, then sunset. We'll provide automated migration tools.
Samir P.: Any security/KMS changes for private deployments?
Lina (docs): Private still requires the same KMS flow. Updated checklist in the private deploy runbook.
Sylvia (product): Thanks everyone. Quick checklist for teams: 1) opt into canary keys, 2) validate SDKs, 3) check quotas, 4) update docs links.
Matt R.: Postmortem hooks in place; if we see regressions, open #incidents and tag eng-oncall.
Jen K.: Thanks — rolling this out now. Ping me if you need canary access. :rocket:
